Rashi on Arakhin 11b:10:1.english: And Hezekiah said - This implies that he was taking counsel.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:10:2.hebrew: אלא לאו נדבה - ונמלך אם ישוררו, וכתיב ״החל שיר ה'״ — שהורו לו ב"ד לשורר:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:10:2.english: Rather, is it not a voluntary [offering] - And he consulted whether they should sing, and it is written, “The song of the Lord began” — for the court instructed him to sing.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:11:1.english: The burnt offering of the New Moon - For it was [that] of the Additional Offering.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:13:1.english: The lamb that comes with the omer - For it is an obligatory burnt offering on the sixteenth of Nisan.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:15:1.hebrew: אלא אמר רב אשי - הא דמימלך, לאו משום דמספקא ליה — דודאי הוקבע ר"ח בזמנו — אלא רשותא הוא דקא נסיב:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:15:1.english: Rather, Rav Ashi said - This [fact] that he consulted [was] not because he was in doubt — for Rosh Chodesh was certainly established at its [proper] time — rather, he was asking permission.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:15:2.english: Just as it is with a prayer leader who consults - And takes permission [as to] whether he may pray.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:15:3.english: You may even say [it was] an obligatory burnt offering - It was the daily burnt offering of every single day.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:16:1.hebrew: זכות ליום זכאי - בניסן נגאלו, בניסן עתידין להיגאל:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:16:1.english: Merit to an auspicious day - In Nisan they were redeemed; in Nisan they are destined to be redeemed.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:17:1.english: The conclusion of Shabbat - The first day of the week [Sunday].

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:17:2.english: And the conclusion of the Sabbatical [year] - [The] eighth [year].

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:17:3.english: And He brought upon them their own iniquity - It is a verse in Psalms, in the psalm [beginning] “O God of vengeance, the Lord”.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:18:1.hebrew: בטל התמיד - שלא היו להם כבשים, מחמת שהיו צרים על ירושלים, ואין יוצא ובא:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:18:1.english: The daily offering ceased - For they had no lambs, because [the enemy] was besieging Jerusalem, and no one was going out or coming in.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:19:1.english: And what is different about a voluntary burnt offering, that it was [offered] - Was it not [the case that] lambs were not available?

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:19:2.english: This is not difficult: merely a young bull happened to come their way - For it is not fit for the daily offering, but is fit for a voluntary burnt offering.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:1:1.hebrew: על עסקי קול - שהיה מצוהו לשורר, לפי שמשה לוי היה:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:1:1.english: Concerning matters of voice - That He commanded him to sing, because Moses was a Levite.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:20:1.hebrew: ותסברא - דשירה גמורה הויא ההיא שירה על קרבן? והא שירה דאחד בשבת — ״לה' הארץ ומלואה״, כדאמר בראש השנה (דף לא.); והאי קרא במזמור ״אל נקמות ה'״, שהוא שיר של רביעי בשבת:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:20:1.english: And can you understand [this] - [Do you think] that that song was a genuine song over an offering? But the song of the first day of the week [Sunday] is “The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof,” as [the Gemara] states in Rosh Hashanah (31a); and this verse is in the psalm “O God of vengeance, the Lord,” which is the song of the fourth day of the week [Wednesday].

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:20:2.hebrew: אילייא - קינה, כדמתרגמינן: ״ושאי על שפים קינה״ — ״וטלי על נגדין אילייא״ (ירמיהו ז׳:כ״ט):
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:20:2.english: Eiliyya - A lamentation, as we translate: “And take up a lamentation on the high hills” — “And lift up a lamentation on the heights” (Jeremiah 7:29).

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:21:1.english: Platform - It was a kind of bench.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:21:2.hebrew: אי הכי - דאפילו שלא על הקרבן אומר שירה, בעולת נדבה נמי לימא, ותפשוט בעיא דר' אבין:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:21:2.english: If so - Since even not over an offering [a Levite] recites song, let him also recite [it] for a voluntary burnt offering, and let Rabbi Avin's dilemma be resolved.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:21:3.hebrew: נפקא מיניה חורבא - דהא דר"ל רשות הוא, דאי אית ליה לעולת נדבה ברשות, אתי למימר עולת חובה נמי רשות. הלכך, לא אמרינן שיר לגמרי בנדבה:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:21:3.english: A mishap would result from it - For this [ruling] of Reish Lakish is [only] optional; for if there is [song] for a voluntary burnt offering as an option, people will come to say: [Song for] an obligatory burnt offering is also optional. Therefore, we do not recite song at all for a voluntary [offering].

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:22:1.english: What came of it - Regarding the dilemma of Rabbi Avin.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:22:2.english: And you shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings - [The verse] juxtaposes a burnt offering to peace offerings, and peace offerings to a burnt offering, with regard to song.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:23:1.hebrew: מה עולה האמורה כאן קדשי קדשים - דאין לך עולה קדשים קלים, אף שלמים האמורים כאן טעונים שיר — בשלמים קדשי קדשים משתעי. ואין לך שלמים קדשי קדשים אלא כבשי עצרת, דשלמי ציבור הן, וכתיב בהו (ויקרא כ״ג:כ׳) קדש יהיו לה' לכהן. ומה שלמים האמורים כאן לגבי שיר קבוע להן זמן — דהא אוקימנא בכבשי עצרת — אף עולה האמורה כאן שקבוע לה זמן, לאפוקי נדבת ציבור, דאין קבוע לה זמן:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:23:1.english: Just as the burnt offering mentioned here is [an offering of] the most sacred order - For there is no burnt offering [that is of] lesser sanctity; so too, regarding the peace offerings mentioned here that require song, [the verse] is speaking of peace offerings of the most sacred order. And there are no peace offerings [that are of] the most sacred order other than the lambs of Atzeret, for they are communal peace offerings, and it is written concerning them (Leviticus 23:20): "They shall be holy to the Lord for the priest." And just as the peace offerings mentioned here with regard to song have a set time — for we have established [them as] the lambs of Atzeret — so too, the burnt offering mentioned here [is one] that has a set time, to exclude a communal voluntary offering, which does not have a set time.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:2:1.hebrew: אף הם - הלוים בעבודת מזבח, ולא משכחת לוים כשרים בעבודת מזבח אלא בשיר:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:2:1.english: So too they - The Levites [participate] in the altar service; and you do not find Levites fit for the altar service except in song.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:2:2.english: Just as you - The verse refers to the priests.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:3:1.hebrew: אתם בשלהם - הכהנים שנכנסו בעבודת לוים, כגון ששררו:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:3:1.english: You in theirs - The priests who entered into the service of the Levites, for example, if they sang.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:3:2.english: And they in yours - A Levite who served on the altar as a priest.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:3:3.hebrew: הם בשלהם - כגון לוי משורר שהגיף דלתות, ולוי משוער שאמר שיר, שהרי הלוים היו חלוקים — זה למשוער וזה למשורר:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:3:3.english: They in theirs - For example, a Levite singer who closed [the] doors, and a Levite gatekeeper who sang [the] song, for the Levites were divided — this one as a gatekeeper and that one as a singer.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:3:4.english: Rather, [only] under a prohibition - It was not explained to us [where this is derived from].

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:4:1.hebrew: אביי - לית ליה הא מתני' דקתני לעיל: ״הם בשלהם אינו במיתה״, דהא משכחת תנא אחרינא דקאי כוותיה:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:4:1.english: Abaye - He does not hold [in accordance with] this teaching that taught above: “[Levites serving] in their own [fellow Levites' roles] is not [punishable] with death,” for you find another Tanna who holds like him.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:4:2.english: An actual stranger - Such as an Israelite.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:4:3.hebrew: הא כתיב חדא זימנא - בההיא פרשתא גופה, וקאי נמי אעבודת לוים:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:4:3.english: Behold, it is written once [already] - In that very same portion, and it also refers to the service of the Levites.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:6:1.hebrew: רבי יהושע ויוחנן בן גודגדא - לוים היו. יוחנן בן גודגדא סבר: משורר ששוער במיתה כשהוא מגיף לבדו, וגזרו רבנן במסייע דלא ליתי למעבד לחודיה. ור' יהושע סבר: אפילו כי עביד לחודיה אינו אלא באזהרה, ולא גזרו רבנן במסייע:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:6:1.english: Rabbi Yehoshua and Yoḥanan ben Gudgeda - [They] were Levites. Yoḥanan ben Gudgeda held [that] a singer who [served as a] gatekeeper is [punishable] with death when he closes [the doors] alone, and the Sages decreed [a prohibition] regarding an assistant, lest he come to perform [it] alone; and Rabbi Yehoshua held [that] even when he performs [it] alone, it is only [under] a prohibition, and the Sages did not decree [a prohibition] regarding an assistant.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:9:1.hebrew: עולת נדבת ציבור - כגון קיץ המזבח, הבא מן השופרות שנותנין בהן מעות מותר חטאת ומותר אשם:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:9:1.english: A communal voluntary burnt offering - Such as the 'summer fruit' of the altar, which comes from the [shofar-shaped] chests into which they place the surplus money of a sin offering and the surplus of a guilt offering.

Rashi on Arakhin 11b:9:2.hebrew: עולותיכם - ותקעתם בחצוצרות על עולותיכם (במדבר י׳:י׳), והיינו שירה:
Rashi on Arakhin 11b:9:2.english: Your burnt offerings - “And you shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings” (Numbers 10:10), and this is song.

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:13:1.hebrew: אלא אמר רמי בריה דרב ייבא כבש הבא עם העומר קא מיבעיא ליה - טובא תימה: מאי ס"ד? דהא אתמול הקריבו תמידין ומוספין — אמאי לא אימלך אלא ממוסף ט"ז דניסן:
Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:13:1.english: "Rather, Rami son of Rav Yeiva said: It was the lamb that comes with the Omer that he was asking about" - This is very astonishing: What was the assumption? For yesterday they offered the daily offerings and additional offerings — [so] why did [Hezekiah] consult only regarding the additional offering of the sixteenth of Nisan?

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:13:2.hebrew: איבעיא להו אי איקבע ר"ח - וקשה לרש"י, דבדברי הימים כתיב האי קרא מקמי "ויועץ המלך לעשות הפסח בחדש השני":
Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:13:2.english: "They asked whether the New Moon was established" - And it is difficult for Rashi, for in Chronicles this verse is written before "And the king took counsel to observe the Passover in the second month."

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:15:1.hebrew: אלא אמר רב (שימי) [אשי] מידי דהוי אשליח דציבורא דממליך - ולעולם לא תפשוט, דנימא דכבש הבא עם העומר הוה:
Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:15:1.english: "Rather, Rav (Shimi) [Ashi] said: It is comparable to a prayer leader who asks permission" - And in any case, do not resolve [the inquiry], for we can say that it was the lamb that comes with the omer.

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:1:1.hebrew: מהכא ויהי כאחד למחצצרים - ובקרא (במדבר י׳:י׳) כתיב: "ותקעתם בחצוצרות על עולותיכם" — אלמא איכא שירה [מן התורה]:
Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:1:1.english: "From here: 'It came to pass, when the trumpeters were as one'" - And in Scripture (Numbers 10:10) it is written: "And you shall sound the trumpets over your burnt offerings" — evidently, there is [an obligation of] song [from the Torah].

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:20:1.hebrew: שירה דיומא לה' הארץ ומלואה (תהילים כ״ד:א׳) - ואם עולת קיץ טעונה שירה, היינו שיר שאמרו בתמיד של שחר בו ביום:
Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:20:1.english: "The song of the day [is] 'The earth is the Lord's, and the fullness thereof'" (Psalms 24:1) - And if an olat kayitz requires song, that is the song that they recited for the morning daily offering on that same day.

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:21:1.hebrew: אי הכי בעולת נדבה - פי' בקונטרס: "ותפשוט בעיא דרבי אבין":
Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:21:1.english: "If so, for a voluntary burnt offering" - The Kuntres [Rashi] explained: "And let the inquiry of Rabbi Avin be resolved."

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:22:1.hebrew: לעולותיכם ולזבחי שלמיכם מה עולה קדשי קדשים אף שלמים כו' ומה שלמים שקבוע להן זמן וכו' - והא ברייתא איתא נמי בזבחים בפ' איזהו מקומן (זבחים דף נה.), ומתניא הכי: מה עולה קדשי קדשים אף שלמים קדשי קדשים, מה עולה טעונה צפון אף שלמים כו' — וליכא התם: ומה שלמים שקבוע להם זמן וכו', כדאיתא הכא. ושמא כל זה — דטעונין צפון ודקבוע להם זמן — היא ברייתא, וכן היה שונה אותה רב מרי הכי, והתם תניא מה שהיה צריך ממנה. א"נ: אין בברייתא כי אם עולה קדשי קדשים אף שלמים קדשי קדשים, (ה"נ ומקשינן) לענין קביעות זמן ולענין טעונה צפון דזבחים. רבינו אלחנן:
Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:22:1.english: "[Over] your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings: Just as a burnt offering is [an offering of] the most sacred order, so too a peace offering, etc., and just as a peace offering has a set time, etc." - And this baraita is also [found] in Zevachim in the chapter [entitled] Eizehu Mekoman (Zevachim 55a), and it is taught there like this: "Just as a burnt offering is [an offering of] the most sacred order, so too a peace offering is [an offering of] the most sacred order; just as a burnt offering requires the north, so too a peace offering, etc." — and it does not state there: "And just as a peace offering has a set time, etc.," as it is found here. And perhaps all of this — that they require the north and that a set time is established for them — was [the text of a single] baraita, and Rav Mari would indeed teach it like this; and there [in Zevachim], it taught [only] what was needed from it. Alternatively, in the baraita there is only: "A burnt offering is [an offering of] the most sacred order, so too a peace offering is [an offering of] the most sacred order" — (and here too, we compare [them]) with regard to the determination of a set time, and with regard to requiring the north in Zevachim. — Rabbeinu Elchanan.

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:5:1.english: A gatekeeper who sang - For in Chronicles (I, 9) it is written [that there were] families who were gatekeepers and families who were singers.

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:5:2.hebrew: מיתיבי - פ"ה: "לא ידענא האי אזהרה מהיכא היא". ורבינו מנחם נ"ע פי', דכתיב (במדבר ח׳:כ״ו): "לשמור משמרת ועבודה לא יעבוד", וכתיב (שם): "ככה תעשה ללוים במשמרותם":
Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:5:2.english: "They raised an objection" - The Kuntres [Rashi] explained: "I do not know from where this prohibition is [derived]." And Rabbeinu Menachem, may he rest in Eden, explained that it is written (Numbers 8:26): "To keep the charge, and he shall do no service," and it is written (ibid.): "Thus shall you do to the Levites concerning their charges."

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:7:1.hebrew: דמר סבר במיתה - אם משוער לבדו, וגזרו בו רבנן מסייע עם אחר; ומ"ס באזהרה, ולא גזרו רבנן אם בא לסייע:
Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:7:1.english: "That one Master holds [it is punishable] by death" - [That is,] if [a singer acts as] a gatekeeper alone, and the Rabbis decreed regarding it [to forbid] assisting another; and one Master holds [that it is only] a prohibition, and the Rabbis did not decree [a restriction] if he comes to assist.

Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:9:1.hebrew: עולת נדבת ציבור טעונה שיר - כגון עולת קיץ, אבל דיחיד — אפי' חובתו אין טעונה נסכים:
Tosafot on Arakhin 11b:9:1.english: "A communal voluntary burnt offering requires song" - Such as the burnt offering for the dessert [of the altar]; but that of an individual, even his obligatory [offering], does not require libations [accompanied by song].
